name: macOS App Launcher
author: @gabeperez
desc: Open, focus, quit apps and set volume by voice. Uses native open -a and osascript — much faster than alternatives. Say "Open Chrome" or "Set volume to 40."

steps.title: Clone the repo
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/gabeperez/macos-app-launcher.git
cd macos-app-launcher
npm install
chmod +x start.sh

steps.title: Try it out
steps.code: "Open Chrome" · "Set volume to 40" · "What apps are open?"
steps.note: Built-in aliases: browser → Chrome, code → Cursor, messages → Beeper

name: Poke Bridge
author: @gabeperez
desc: Voice-activate your iMessage AI agent. Trigger Poke to send emails, set reminders, add calendar events, and more — all without touching your phone.
requirements: Poke account + V2 API key · Node.js 18+ · macOS or Windows

steps.title: Clone and install
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/gabeperez/poke-bridge.git
cd poke-bridge
npm install

steps.title: Configure your API key
steps.note: Edit start.sh and replace your_v2_key_here with your Poke V2 key from poke.com/kitchen

steps.title: Try it out
steps.code:
"Ask Poke to remind me to call the client at 9am"
"Tell Poke to draft an email to the team"
"Have Poke add a standup Monday at 10am"
